segments.traditional: 這裡有多少錢，你可以幫我
segments.simplified: 这里有多少钱，你可以帮我

repairs.note: 一點兒 is a small amount of something (喝一點兒水). A quick action takes 一下 after the verb.
有一點兒 goes before a feeling or quality (有一點兒累). A quick action takes 一下 after the verb.

items.fallbackRepair: 一下 comes right after the verb: 算一下.

result.traditional: 這裡有多少錢，你可以幫我算一下嗎？
result.simplified: 这里有多少钱，你可以帮我算一下吗？
result.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu duōshǎo qián, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ suàn yíxià ma?
result.english: How much money is here? Could you count it for me?

repairs.note: B answers 馬上來: B is coming to where A is, so A asks with 來.
一點兒 is a small amount of something. A short visit takes 一下 after the verb.

items.fallbackRepair: 一下 comes right after the verb, before the place: 來一下我的辦公室.

result.traditional: 你可以來一下我的辦公室嗎？
result.simplified: 你可以来一下我的办公室吗？
result.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ lái yíxià wǒ de bàngōngshì ma?
result.english: Could you come to my office for a moment?

repairs.note: 覺得 gives an opinion and needs something after it (我覺得很好). Thinking it over for a moment is 想一下.
知道 is knowing, not a short action, so it cannot take 一下. She needs a moment to think: 想一下.

items.fallbackRepair: Who, then the action, then 一下: 我想一下.

result.traditional: 我想一下。
result.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yíxià.
result.english: Let me think for a moment.

segments.traditional: 我覺得非常不舒服，好像發燒了。
segments.simplified: 我觉得非常不舒服，好像发烧了。

repairs.note: 很好 describes something (這個很好). Advice puts 最好 before the action.
A feels sick with a fever, so the advice is to rest, not to exercise.

items.fallbackRepair: 最好 comes before what the person should do: 最好在家休息.

result.traditional: 那你最好在家休息。
result.pinyin: Nà nǐ zuìhǎo zài jiā xiūxí.
result.english: Then you had better rest at home.

segments.traditional: 我今天上課遲到了，老師有一點兒不高興。
segments.simplified: 我今天上课迟到了，老师有一点儿不高兴。

repairs.note: A was late today, so tomorrow A should come earlier, not later.
比較 means "rather" and only describes (比較忙). Advice puts 最好 before the action.

items.fallbackRepair: 最好 first, then how to do it: 最好早一點兒來.

result.traditional: 你明天最好早一點兒來。
result.simplified: 你明天最好早一点儿来。
result.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān zuìhǎo zǎo yìdiǎnr lái.
result.english: You had better come a little earlier tomorrow.

segments.traditional: 今年我想到台北101去跨年。

repairs.note: 不可以 is a rule (這裡不可以停車), not advice. After 最好, "don't" is 不要.
好像 means "it seems". To give advice use 最好.

items.fallbackRepair: Advice against something is 最好 + 不要 + the action.

result.traditional: 那天人很多，你最好不要開車去。
result.simplified: 那天人很多，你最好不要开车去。
result.pinyin: Nà tiān rén hěn duō, nǐ zuìhǎo búyào kāichē qù.
result.english: It will be very crowded that day. You had better not drive there.

repairs.note: 和 joins things (書和筆), not two qualities of one thing. The second one takes 也.
Good-looking and not expensive are both good points, so nothing turns: 不但…，也….

items.fallbackRepair: 不但 before the first quality, 也 before the second: 不但好看，也不貴.

result.traditional: 我買的這件衣服不但好看，也不貴。
result.simplified: 我买的这件衣服不但好看，也不贵。
result.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi de zhè jiàn yīfu búdàn hǎokàn, yě bú guì.
result.english: This piece of clothing I bought is not only good-looking but also inexpensive.

alternatives.traditional: 我買的這件衣服不但不貴，也好看。
alternatives.simplified: 我买的这件衣服不但不贵，也好看。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi de zhè jiàn yīfu búdàn bú guì, yě hǎokàn.
alternatives.english: This piece of clothing I bought is not only inexpensive but also good-looking.

repairs.note: 都 sums up several things said before it (英文、法文都很好). Here the second language adds on with 也.
Here 還是 would mean "or" or "still". After 不但, the second good point takes 也: 法文也很好.

items.fallbackRepair: Two different things are good, so 也 comes after the second one: 法文也很好.

result.traditional: 我的印尼朋友不但英文很好，法文也很好。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de Yìnní péngyǒu búdàn Yīngwén hěn hǎo, Fǎwén yě hěn hǎo.
result.english: My Indonesian friend is not only good at English but also good at French.

alternatives.traditional: 我的印尼朋友不但法文很好，英文也很好。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǒ de Yìnní péngyǒu búdàn Fǎwén hěn hǎo, Yīngwén yě hěn hǎo.
alternatives.english: My Indonesian friend is not only good at French but also good at English.

repairs.note: 和 joins things (書和筆), not two actions. The second action takes 也.
Classes and work both make B busy. Nothing turns, so it is 不但…，也….

items.fallbackRepair: One person does both, so 不但 comes after 我, and 也 starts the second action.

result.traditional: 因為我不但要上課，也要工作，所以比較忙。
result.simplified: 因为我不但要上课，也要工作，所以比较忙。
result.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ búdàn yào shàngkè, yě yào gōngzuò, suǒyǐ bǐjiào máng.
result.english: Because I not only have classes but also have to work, so I am rather busy.

segments.traditional: 這家店的麵包很好吃，每天下午三點以前就
segments.simplified: 这家店的面包很好吃，每天下午三点以前就

repairs.note: This sentence is about the shop and its bread: the shop sells it (賣).
V到 means managing to get something (買到了). "None left" is V完.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb first, then 完: 賣完了.

result.traditional: 這家店的麵包很好吃，每天下午三點以前就賣完了。
result.simplified: 这家店的面包很好吃，每天下午三点以前就卖完了。
result.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, měitiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǐqián jiù màiwán le.
result.english: This shop's bread is delicious; it is sold out before three every afternoon.

repairs.note: It is morning (早上) and he then goes to work, so the meal is breakfast.
吃到 means managing to get something to eat. Finishing the meal is 吃完.

items.fallbackRepair: 完 comes right after the verb, before the thing: 吃完早飯.

result.traditional: 王先生早上吃完早飯，就去上班了。
result.simplified: 王先生早上吃完早饭，就去上班了。
result.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng zǎoshàng chīwán zǎofàn, jiù qù shàngbān le.
result.english: Mr. Wang finished breakfast this morning and then went to work.

segments.traditional: 我現在要去超級市場買東西，要買牛奶嗎？
segments.simplified: 我现在要去超级市场买东西，要买牛奶吗？

repairs.note: If the milk were finished, they would buy more now. 明天再買 means some is left: 還沒喝完.
Something not finished yet is 還沒 + V完. 不 does not go with a result that has not happened.
Milk is something you drink: 喝.

items.fallbackRepair: Not finished yet: 還沒, then the verb, then 完.

result.traditional: 昨天買的牛奶還沒喝完，明天再買吧！
result.simplified: 昨天买的牛奶还没喝完，明天再买吧！
result.pinyin: Zuótiān mǎi de niúnǎi háiméi hēwán, míngtiān zài mǎi ba!
result.english: We haven't finished the milk we bought yesterday. Let's buy more tomorrow!

B2L01-G05-P38.title: Look at the pictures and complete the sentences.

scene.alt: A little girl sitting on a wooden chair.

repairs.note: Look at the picture: the child is sitting, not standing.
After 在 comes a place. A thing becomes a place with 上: 椅子上.

items.fallbackRepair: With 坐, the place comes after the verb: 坐在椅子上.

result.traditional: 孩子坐在椅子上。
result.pinyin: Háizi zuò zài yǐzi shàng.
result.english: The child is sitting on the chair.

scene.alt: Two students standing in front of a convenience store.

repairs.note: Look at the picture: the two students are standing.
Look at the picture: they are outside, in front of the shop.

items.fallbackRepair: With 站, the place comes after the verb: 站在商店前面.

result.traditional: 有兩個學生站在商店前面。
result.simplified: 有两个学生站在商店前面。
result.pinyin: Yǒu liǎng ge xuéshēng zhàn zài shāngdiàn qiánmiàn.
result.english: Two students are standing in front of the shop.

scene.alt: A man writing a phone number on a sheet of paper.

repairs.note: A phone number is written down, not put somewhere: 寫在.
Look at the picture: he is writing on a sheet of paper, not in a book.

items.fallbackRepair: Where the number ends up comes after the verb: 寫在紙上.

result.traditional: 他的電話號碼寫在紙上。
result.simplified: 他的电话号码写在纸上。
result.pinyin: Tā de diànhuà hàomǎ xiě zài zhǐ shàng.
result.english: His phone number is written on the paper.

repairs.note: A gift costs nothing. There is a price (一件五十塊), so the clothes were sold: 賣給.
寄給 is mailing something to someone. The price tells you the clothes were sold: 賣給.
You write a letter or a card to someone (寫給), not clothes.

items.fallbackRepair: The price tells you what happened to the clothes: 賣給.

result.traditional: 那些舊衣服，我賣給同學了，一件五十塊。
result.simplified: 那些旧衣服，我卖给同学了，一件五十块。
result.pinyin: Nàxiē jiù yīfu, wǒ mài gěi tóngxué le, yí jiàn wǔshí kuài.
result.english: I sold those old clothes to a classmate, fifty dollars apiece.

segments.traditional: 這些漂亮的鉛筆，你打算
segments.simplified: 这些漂亮的铅笔，你打算

repairs.note: The one who receives a gift is a person, so ask with 誰.
在 marks a place (放在桌上). The person who receives takes 給.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb, then 給, then the person: 送給誰.

result.traditional: 這些漂亮的鉛筆，你打算送給誰？
result.simplified: 这些漂亮的铅笔，你打算送给谁？
result.pinyin: Zhèxiē piàoliàng de qiānbǐ, nǐ dǎsuàn sòng gěi shéi?
result.english: Who do you plan to give these pretty pencils to?

repairs.note: After 是, the sentence closes with 的 (是…的), not 了.
寫在 says where something is written (寫在紙上). The person the card is for takes 給: 寫給我.

items.fallbackRepair: 寫給, then the person, and 的 closes 是…的: 寫給我的.

result.traditional: 這張卡片是我朋友寫給我的。
result.simplified: 这张卡片是我朋友写给我的。
result.pinyin: Zhè zhāng kǎpiàn shì wǒ péngyǒu xiě gěi wǒ de.
result.english: This card was written to me by my friend.

B2L01-G07-P39.title: Look at the pictures and complete the sentences.

scene.alt: A man driving a red car with music notes around him.

repairs.note: Look at the picture: he is in a car, driving, not walking.
Two actions at the same time take 一邊 before each one, not 也.

items.fallbackRepair: 一邊 goes before each of the two actions.

result.traditional: 很多人常常一邊開車，一邊聽音樂。
result.simplified: 很多人常常一边开车，一边听音乐。
result.pinyin: Hěn duō rén chángcháng yìbiān kāichē, yìbiān tīng yīnyuè.
result.english: Many people often listen to music while driving.

alternatives.traditional: 很多人常常一邊聽音樂，一邊開車。
alternatives.simplified: 很多人常常一边听音乐，一边开车。
alternatives.pinyin: Hěn duō rén chángcháng yìbiān tīng yīnyuè, yìbiān kāichē.
alternatives.english: Many people often drive while listening to music.

scene.alt: A boy eating from a bowl in front of the television.

repairs.note: Look at the picture: the child is eating and watching television, not sleeping.
和 joins things (書和筆), not two actions. Put 邊 before each action.

items.fallbackRepair: 邊 goes before each of the two actions: 邊吃飯邊看電視.

result.traditional: 媽媽不希望孩子邊吃飯邊看電視。
result.simplified: 妈妈不希望孩子边吃饭边看电视。
result.pinyin: Māma bù xīwàng háizi biān chīfàn biān kàn diànshì.
result.english: Mom doesn't want her child to watch television while eating.

alternatives.traditional: 媽媽不希望孩子邊看電視邊吃飯。
alternatives.simplified: 妈妈不希望孩子边看电视边吃饭。
alternatives.pinyin: Māma bù xīwàng háizi biān kàn diànshì biān chīfàn.
alternatives.english: Mom doesn't want her child to eat while watching television.

scene.alt: A man and a woman chatting at a café table with cups of coffee.

segments.traditional: 他喜歡跟朋友在咖啡廳
segments.simplified: 他喜欢跟朋友在咖啡厅

repairs.note: 先…再… puts one action after the other. In the picture they drink and chat at the same time: 一邊…，一邊….
先…再… puts one action after the other. In the picture they drink and chat at the same time: 一邊…，一邊….

items.fallbackRepair: 一邊 goes before each of the two actions.

result.traditional: 他喜歡跟朋友在咖啡廳一邊喝咖啡，一邊聊天。

result.english: He likes to chat with friends over coffee at the café.

alternatives.traditional: 他喜歡跟朋友在咖啡廳一邊聊天，一邊喝咖啡。
alternatives.simplified: 他喜欢跟朋友在咖啡厅一边聊天，一边喝咖啡。
alternatives.pinyin: Tā xǐhuān gēn péngyǒu zài kāfēitīng yìbiān liáotiān, yìbiān hē kāfēi.
alternatives.english: He likes to drink coffee while chatting with friends at the café.

segments.traditional: 那件裙子非常貴，你還要買嗎？
segments.simplified: 那件裙子非常贵，你还要买吗？

repairs.note: The high price is not B's reason for buying. B accepts it and buys anyway: 雖然.
Liking the skirt goes against its high price, so the second half turns with 可是.

items.fallbackRepair: 雖然 opens the part B accepts, and 可是 turns to what matters more.

result.traditional: 雖然很貴，可是我很喜歡，還是要買。
result.simplified: 虽然很贵，可是我很喜欢，还是要买。
result.pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, kěshì wǒ hěn xǐhuān, háishì yào mǎi.
result.english: Although it is expensive, I like it a lot, so I still want to buy it.

segments.traditional: 你為什麼住在這麼小的房子？
segments.simplified: 你为什么住在这么小的房子？

repairs.note: A asks why B lives there, so after 可是 comes the good side. A high price is no reason to stay.
Small and cheap pull in different directions, so the second half turns with 可是.

items.fallbackRepair: Start with what A said (it is small), then turn to the good side after 可是.

result.traditional: 雖然這個房子很小，可是很便宜。
result.simplified: 虽然这个房子很小，可是很便宜。
result.pinyin: Suīrán zhège fángzi hěn xiǎo, kěshì hěn piányí.
result.english: Although this house is small, it is cheap.

alternatives.traditional: 這個房子雖然很小，可是很便宜。
alternatives.simplified: 这个房子虽然很小，可是很便宜。
alternatives.pinyin: Zhège fángzi suīrán hěn xiǎo, kěshì hěn piányí.
alternatives.english: Although this house is small, it is cheap.

segments.traditional: 你玩遊戲常常輸，為什麼還要玩？
segments.simplified: 你玩游戏常常输，为什么还要玩？

repairs.note: A asks why B still plays. B must enjoy it: 很好玩.
不但…也… adds a second point of the same kind. Losing and still enjoying it is a turn: 雖然…，可是….
The second half goes against the first, so it turns with 可是, not 也.

items.fallbackRepair: 雖然 opens the part B accepts, and 可是 turns to why B still plays.

result.traditional: 雖然我常常輸，可是我覺得很好玩。
result.simplified: 虽然我常常输，可是我觉得很好玩。
result.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ chángcháng shū, kěshì wǒ juéde hěn hǎowán.
result.english: Although I often lose, I think it is a lot of fun.

segments.traditional: 良介在做什麼？我有事情想問他。
segments.simplified: 良介在做什么？我有事情想问他。

repairs.note: 嗎 asks a yes/no question. B is telling A what is going on, with 呢 for emphasis.
的 does not close a sentence about what someone is doing right now. B stresses it with 呢.

items.fallbackRepair: 在 before the action, and 呢 at the very end: 他在睡覺呢！

result.traditional: 他在睡覺呢！你等一下再來找他吧。
result.simplified: 他在睡觉呢！你等一下再来找他吧。
result.pinyin: Tā zài shuìjiào ne! Nǐ děng yíxià zài lái zhǎo tā ba.
result.english: He is sleeping! Come back for him a bit later.

segments.traditional: 這個週末妳要不要跟我去博物館？
segments.simplified: 这个周末你要不要跟我去博物馆？

repairs.note: 嗎 asks a yes/no question. The older sister is explaining why she is busy, with 呢 for emphasis.
She says 我沒空, so she does have a lot of homework: 還有.

items.fallbackRepair: 還有, then what she still has, and 呢 at the very end.

result.traditional: 我沒空，我還有很多功課呢！
result.simplified: 我没空，我还有很多功课呢！
result.pinyin: Wǒ méi kòng, wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō gōngkè ne!
result.english: I'm not free. I still have a lot of homework!

segments.traditional: 為什麼你每天都喝珍珠奶茶？
segments.simplified: 为什么你每天都喝珍珠奶茶？

segments.traditional: 珍珠奶茶又便宜又好喝，所以我

repairs.note: 嗎 asks a yes/no question. B is giving a reason, with 呢 for emphasis.
Before a measure word, "two" is 兩: 兩杯.

items.fallbackRepair: How often (一天), then the action, then how much, and 呢 at the very end: 一天喝兩杯呢！

result.traditional: 珍珠奶茶又便宜又好喝，所以我一天喝兩杯呢！
result.simplified: 珍珠奶茶又便宜又好喝，所以我一天喝两杯呢！
result.pinyin: Zhēnzhū nǎichá yòu piányí yòu hǎohē, suǒyǐ wǒ yì tiān hē liǎng bēi ne!
result.english: Bubble tea is cheap and tasty, so I drink two cups a day!
